2: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. ALEPH I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
3: My soul shall boast in the Lord. The humble shall hear of it, and be glad.
4: Oh magnify the Lord with me. Let us exalt his name together.
5: I sought the Lord, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
6: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
7: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
8: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
9: Oh taste and see that the Lord is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
10: Oh fear the Lord, you his holy ones, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
11: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the Lord shall not lack any good thing.
12: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
13: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
14: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
15: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
16: The Lord 's eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
17: The Lord 's face is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.
18: They cried, and the Lord hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
19: The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
20: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him out of them all.
21: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
22: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
23: The Lord redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
